name: GymBuddy AI — Telegram Coach (open to everyone)

parameters.content:
## 🏋️ GymBuddy AI — Telegram Coach (open to everyone)
Part 1 (top): **the bot**. Anyone on Telegram can use it, no website account needed: /profile, /today, /workout, /muscle, /cook (recipe + dish image), 📷 photo scan, /scan barcode, /eat, /done, /log, /report, or any free question.

Part 2 (bottom): **3 schedules** push messages without being asked: 07:30 morning brief, 20:30 streak nudge, Sunday 19:00 weekly recap.

Data: the live GymBuddy API (profile, targets, workouts, restaurants, chatbot, vision, fridge chef) + 3 tabs in the Google Sheet (`TG_Subscribers`, `TG_Workouts`, `TG_Meals`).

Built on ideas from the n8n community templates #7756 (John Alejandro Silva) and #16969 (Dr. Firas). See automation/TELEGRAM_COACH.md.

**Setup (n8n Cloud or self-hosted, no environment variables):** replace `REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` with your sheet ID, then create 4 credentials: Telegram API, Google Sheets OAuth2, Header Auth `OpenRouter API` (Authorization = Bearer sk-or-...), Header Auth `GymBuddy API Key` (X-API-Key = backend AUTOMATION_API_KEY).

Using the member JSON, write max 120 words: 1) today's session focus with 2-3 key exercises and one technique cue (respect equipment and injuries), 2) one simple meal idea that fits the calorie/protein targets and respects diet and allergies, 3) one short motivational line that mentions the streak if it is above 0. Use short lines and emojis, no tables, no markdown headings. Answer in the member's language (en or fr)." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ ...$json.member, streak: $json.streak, weekday: $now.toFormat('cccc') }) } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
### 💬 Bot commands
Every message first passes *Attach Subscriber & Route*: new Telegram users are registered automatically, and a GymBuddy API user is created from their `/profile` (recreated if the API database was reset). *Save Member* stores them in `TG_Subscribers`. One Switch then routes the command. `/link email` is optional (to reuse an app profile). Free text goes to the app's RAG chatbot (`/api/chat`); if the app can't answer, the AI model answers directly.

### ⏰ Scheduled coaching
Morning brief (AI, 1 request per member), evening nudge (no AI, only members who planned to train and haven't sent /done), Sunday recap (AI, uses the logged workouts and meals).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are GymBuddy, a motivating gym coach. Write a Telegram good-morning message (max 90 words) for this member: greet by first name, today's session focus with one key exercise and cue (or a recovery idea on rest days), the calorie/protein/water targets in one line, one breakfast idea that respects diet and allergies, and a punchy closing line (mention the streak if above 0). Emojis welcome, no headings. Answer in the member's language." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ ...$json.member, streak: $json.streak, weekday: $now.toFormat('cccc') }) } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openrouter/free', temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are GymBuddy, a supportive coach. Write a Telegram weekly recap (max 110 words) from these stats: celebrate the wins with numbers, point out ONE thing to improve next week (training consistency, protein or calories vs target, or logging more meals), and give one concrete mini-challenge for next week. Emojis welcome, no headings. Answer in the member's language." }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json.stats) } ] }) }}
